alex-finance: FYI vendor XState (IN) invoiced us and added 18% GST. We're a US customer (Redwood Inc, US billing addr). Shouldn't this be zero-rated as export of services?

priya-tax: Likely yes. For cross-border B2B SaaS, place of supply is usually the recipient's location (US) -> export of services, zero-rated. Vendor shouldn't charge IGST if they qualify as export. Need vendor GSTIN validation and invoice wording changed to 'export of services under Section 7, zero-rated'. Also ask for LUT/IEC if they rely on LUT.

vidya-vendor: Hi all  we billed with GST because our billing system defaulted to domestic tax. We have GSTIN 27AABCU1234R1Z2. If you confirm export, we'll reissue.

acct-pay: We paid via bank transfer but can hold funds if reissue will be net-zero. What's the safe path?

priya-tax: Ask vendor to: 1) provide VIES-style GSTIN check (or screenshot of GST portal lookup), 2) issue credit note for original invoice and reissue invoice showing 0% GST and wording: 'Export of services - zero rated under IGST Act'. Attach proof of export (PO, contract, US billing address). If they charged GST and refund isn't possible quickly, we can process credit note + new invoice.

alex-finance: Example invoice change request I'll send to vendor:

```
Please issue:
- Credit note referencing INV-2026-1180
- New invoice: amount 2,500 USD
- GST: 0.00 INR (Export of services - zero rated)
- Note: Supply to Redwood Inc, 450 Market St, San Francisco, CA, USA. IEC/LUT on file: (attach if applicable)
```

Will ping vendor.

vidya-vendor: Understood. We'll validate GSTIN on the portal and reissue credit + corrected invoice within 48 hrs.

ledger-bot: Invoice logged: INV-2026-1180. Link: https://billing.redwood/invoices/INV-2026-1180

acct-pay: Please attach vendor GST portal screenshot and new invoice to ticket FIN-5342 when available.

priya-tax: One more note: keep evidence of contract, proof of payment, and communications in case of tax audit. If vendor insists they must charge GST, ask for legal basis; we can escalate.

alex-finance: Thanks  closing after FIN-5342 is updated.
